name: Analyze Mitochondrial Morphology And Potential
description: Quantifies metrics of mitochondrial morphology and membrane potential from fluorescence microscopy images.
detailed_description: Quantifies metrics of mitochondrial morphology and membrane potential from fluorescence microscopy images.
when_to_use: When you need analyze mitochondrial morphology and potential analysis

parameters.morphology_image_path: [Required] Path to the fluorescence microscopy image showing mitochondrial morphology (e.g., MTS-GFP) (str)
parameters.potential_image_path: [Required] Path to the fluorescence microscopy image showing mitochondrial membrane potential (e.g., TMRE staining) (str)
